# 🚨 Incident Report Template

## Incident summary
- Incident ID:
- Start/end time and timezone:
- Reporter/owner:
- Affected version:
- Severity:

## Impact
Describe affected users, affected artifacts, scope, and known data/security consequences.

## Timeline
| Time | Event | Evidence |
|---|---|---|

## Detection and response
Describe how the issue was identified, containment steps, recovery, and communications.

## Root cause
Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses.

## Corrective actions
| Action | Owner | Priority | Due date | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Lessons and approval
Record prevention changes, follow-up review, and closure decision.
